## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible result of this change.

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran.

## UI changes

Add before/after images when the change affects visible behavior, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the reason tests are unnecessary is explained above.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior, configuration, or architecture changed.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, build output, or local database files are included.
- [ ] `engine/upstream/` was not edited directly.
